info.title: quiva.ai Gateway
info.description: API for managing document templates, documents, and e-signature workflows in the quiva.ai platform

tags.name: Templates
tags.description: Template lifecycle — create, read, publish, validate, trigger, and delete document templates.

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Document lifecycle — read, update, and delete generated documents.

tags.name: Signatures
tags.description: E-signature workflows powered by HelloSign (Dropbox Sign).

get.description: Retrieve a single document template by key. Pass `?draft=true` to fetch the draft version; omit or set `false` to fetch the published version.

patch.description: Update an existing draft template. Unlike `POST /templates`, this does not check for pre-existence — it will create or overwrite.

delete.description: Delete a draft or published template. Set `?draft=true` to target the draft version. Deletion is implemented as a poison-pill tombstone message.

get.description: List all templates. Pass `?draft=true` to list draft templates instead of published ones.

post.description: Create a new draft template. Returns `402` if a template with the same key already exists.

402.description: Template with this key already exists.

post.description: Promote a draft template to published state. The published version is what `template-trigger` uses to generate documents.
Validate a base64-encoded template file before storing it. Returns a list of any template tag errors found.

patch.description: Remove specific fields from a draft template by dot-notation path. Useful for clearing individual properties without overwriting the entire record.

post.description: Generate one or more documents from published templates. Each entry in `list` specifies a template key and optional output overrides. The `payload` object is used for template variable substitution. This is an asynchronous operation — the response confirms jobs were queued.

200.description: Trigger jobs queued. Check `errors` on each result for per-template failures.

errors: Document template with key: invoice-template does not have a template source

get.description: Retrieve a single document by key.

patch.description: Create or update a document record directly. Used to manually set document metadata outside of a template trigger workflow.

delete.description: Delete a document record. Implemented as a poison-pill tombstone message.

get.description: List documents matching a subject query. The query supports stream wildcard patterns such as `contracts.*` (single level) or `contracts.>` (any depth).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Stream subject query filter, e.g. `contracts.*` or `contracts.>`.

patch.description: Remove specific fields from a document record by dot-notation path.

get.description: Generate an embedded signing URL for a specific signature on a document. Only available for signatures created in embedded signing mode.

post.description: Webhook endpoint for HelloSign signature events. Handles `signature_request_signed`, `signature_request_all_signed`, and `signature_request_invalid` events. Unrecognised event types are silently ignored. Called by the HelloSign platform, not by internal services.

DocumentKey.name: key
DocumentKey.description: Unique document key, typically a file path.

QueryDraft.name: draft
QueryDraft.description: When `true`, targets the draft version of a template. Defaults to published.

TemplateSignatoryValidity.description: How long a signatory has to complete signing before the request expires.

name.description: Signatory name. Supports template variable syntax e.g. `{{client_name}}`.

email.description: Signatory email. Supports template variable syntax e.g. `{{client_email}}`.

key.description: Key of the sub-template to merge.

conditions.description: Rule-engine condition object. Sub-template is only included if conditions evaluate to true.

name.description: Output filename template. Supports variable substitution.

folder.description: Output folder path within the bucket.

source.description: Reference to the source template file in object storage.

key.description: Object store path of the template file.

content_type.description: MIME type of the source file.

TemplateUpsertRequest.description: Request body for creating or updating a template.

DocumentSignatoryRequest.description: Signature request object attached to the signatory after a HelloSign request is sent.

is_embedded.description: Whether the signing is done via an embedded iframe.

expiry.description: ISO 8601 datetime after which the signing request expires.

signed_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the signatory signed. Null if not yet signed.

error.description: Error message if the signature request failed.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the document was created.

output.description: Reference to the generated output file in object storage.

key.description: Object store URI for the generated file.

template.description: Reference to the template used to generate this document.

errors.description: Generation errors, if the document failed to produce output.

key.description: Document key — used to derive the storage subject.
Key of the record to modify.

template.description: Key of the published template to trigger.

payload.description: Key-value map used for template variable substitution.

list.description: One or more template trigger entries.

subject.description: Messaging subject of the queued document. Present on success.

errors.description: Validation or processing errors. Present on failure.
example: Document template with key: invoice-template does not have a template source

results_total.description: Number of results in this response.

next_sequence.description: Sequence number to use for the next page.

total_messages.description: Total number of messages in the stream for this subject.

subject.description: Messaging subject of the created or updated resource.

body.error: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
